1. (Judgment 4) At 1440 the quote is set one word per line down a very narrow left rail. The run "Do not / follow / the / ideas… / listen" fills the whole 900px fold and is cut by the bottom edge, so "to the voice within", the amber outline "yourself" and the Dogen attribution all fall below the fold. Widen the quote block to the brief's columns 1–8 of the 2.3fr field so the 15 words set as a reading block of four or five lines with "yourself" and "— Dogen" above 900px. The phone version (fold 1 of 5) already sets it correctly.

2. (Judgment 3) Because of that wrapping, the desktop hero reads as a vertical word stack, not the declared left-aligned italic reading column. The one violation, upright amber outline "yourself", never shows in the desktop view. Without it the `texture: outline` declaration and the brief's single focal point are missing from the 1440 composition.

3. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman entry reads "A founder's bet taken end to end: product strategy, interface, and the code underneath it carried by one pair of hands. The lesson that still runs the shop — go deep in both crafts…". The records describe Spaceman as the LLC Doug has run for a decade, partnering with companies and studios on product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand for clients such as Zeldman and Rolex. Replace this with copy drawn from the record's problem, approach and outcome text.

4. (Judgment 5) The role line "DESIGNER & ENGINEER" in the header and footer, and "Designer & Engineer — deep in both, not a generalist" in the footer, don't match `identity.role`, which is "Product Designer & Developer". Use the recorded role.

5. (Judgment 6) The declared `nav_form` is `list`, but each row is prefixed 01 / 02 / 03, which is the `numbered` form. Drop the numerals and keep the lowercase labels with one hairline rule per row.

6. (Judgment 4) The Mobile Declaration says fold 1 holds the quote plus the 48px mark and nothing else. Fold 1 also carries the "Doug March" wordm

[check 2] The largest first-fold text measures 104px at 1440; the declared hero_scale clamp(26px, 5.5vw, 80px) resolves to 79.2px there (131%, over the 75-125% band). Set the hero element's font-size to exactly clamp(26px, 5.5vw, 80px).

1. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman standfirst says "One pair of hands across the whole stack rather than files handed between two teams." The record says Doug worked "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team," so the page claims something the record contradicts. Cut that sentence or replace it with record wording, such as the list of disciplines: "product design, frontend engineering, design systems, and brand."
2. (Judgment 5) "The studio behind the client work" is also not in the record, which calls Spaceman "the LLC I've operated under for the past decade, partnering with companies and studios across industries." Use the record's phrasing instead.
3. (Judgment 4) At 360 the Mobile Declaration says `first_fold` holds the Dogen quote and the mark, "nothing else." Fold 1 also shows the "Doug March" wordmark, the role line and the "work" nav row, because the hero field ends about 395px down. Make the hero field fill the first 640px fold so the margin band starts below it.

What carries the design is Dogen's line in light italic, hung off the left rail of a deep indigo field, with "yourself." breaking out upright in amber outline; the working right margin holds the brand, the lowercase ruled nav and the day's facts, and on the phone the quote holds the first fold alone with the mark.
